name: VL E-Governance & IT Solutions Ltd
about:

keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
VLEGITL is a subsidiary of Vakrangee Ltd. It specializes in e-governance services, IT/ITES system integration, B2B trading, and IT/ITES equipment trading. Company functions as a systems integrator and end-to-end service provider for various e-government projects.
